/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace')
plan = json.loads((root / '.exp_agent/round_01/plan.json').read_text())
report = json.loads((root / '.exp_agent/round_01/completion.json').read_text())
schema = json.loads((root / '.exp_agent/round_01/completion-schema.json').read_text())

expected_rules = [rule['rule'] for rule in plan['rules']]
assert report['selected_rules'] == expected_rules, (report['selected_rules'], expected_rules)
assert report['blocked'] == []
assert report['unresolved_external'] == []
assert len(report['entity_repairs']) == sum(len(rule['files']) for rule in plan['rules'])

def key(rule, path):
    return rule, path
expected = {}
for rule in plan['rules']:
    for file_info in rule['files']:
        expected[key(rule['rule'], file_info['relative_path'])] = file_info['locations']
actual = {}
for repair in report['entity_repairs']:
    assert repair['status'] == 'repaired'
    assert repair['entities'] and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in repair['entities'])
    assert repair['evidence'] and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in repair['evidence'])
    assert repair['transformation']
    k = key(repair['rule'], repair['relative_path'])
    assert k not in actual, k
    actual[k] = repair['locations']
assert set(actual) == set(expected), (set(expected) - set(actual), set(actual) - set(expected))
for k, locations in expected.items():
    got = [{name: loc[name] for name in ('line', 'column')} for loc in actual[k]]
    want = [{name: loc[name] for name in ('line', 'column')} for loc in locations]
    assert got == want, (k, got, want)
assert sum(len(v) for v in actual.values()) == plan['finding_count'] == 100

# Minimal schema checks for the supplied schema's required constraints.
required_top = set(schema['required'])
assert required_top <= set(report)
for repair in report['entity_repairs']:
    assert set(schema['properties']['entity_repairs']['items']['required']) <= set(repair)
    assert isinstance(repair['locations'], list) and repair['locations']
    for loc in repair['locations']:
        assert isinstance(loc['line'], int) and isinstance(loc['column'], int)
print('completion: valid JSON, required shape valid, all 100 plan locations represented')
PY
